== Notes ==
* As mentioned in some of the ability descriptions, '''Kayle's''' basic attacks within 175 units will always use her melee animation, even after becoming ranged, not utilizing projectiles.
** Basic attacks empowered by ''Starfire Spellblade'' have a 200 "melee" range.
* Basic attacks made while '''Kayle''' is {{tip|silence|silenced}} will function as normal, while lacking a visual projectile.

** On the Original skin [[File:Kayle OriginalCircle.png|32px]] becomes [[File:Kayle OriginalCircle Ascension.png|32px]].

==Trivia==

;{{ci|Kayle|variant=old4|size=32|Kayle, the Judicator}}
* Kayle was the first to have her dance changed after release, (followed by {{ci|Veigar}}) the first to have her abilities reworked three times since release, (followed by {{ci|Ryze}}) and the first to use Chinese artwork outside Asian servers.
* Kayle - {{ci|Morgana}} is one of seven pairs of sibling champions (the others being {{ci|Cassiopeia}} - {{ci|Katarina}}, {{ci|Garen}} - {{ci|Lux}}, {{ci|Nasus}} - {{ci|Renekton}}, {{ci|Yasuo}} - {{ci|Yone}}, {{ci|Darius}} - {{ci|Draven}}, and {{ci|Vi}} - {{ci|Jinx}}).
**Though not a pair, {{ci|Anivia}}, {{ci|Ornn}}, and {{ci|Volibear}} are also siblings.
* During [[Alpha Test]], she was simply called 'Judicator' and at one point she was incorrectly listed as a {{tip|tank}}.
* Her old dance referenced {{w|Will Smith|Will Smith's}} [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GCFRJEjM3fc "Jump on It"] dance from {{w|The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air}}.
** A side-by-side comparison can be seen [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FtsJLKw5aWA here].
** She shared this dance with {{ci|Singed}}.
* Her new dance is a reference to the dance of Elaine Benes from [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Little_Kicks Seinfeld "The Little Kicks"].
* In the now-removed official League of Legends [https://web.archive.org/web/20130726165848/http://forums.na.leagueoflegends.com/board/ forums], the [[File:Intervention_old.png|20px]] original icon of {{ai|Intervention|Kayle|image=Intervention.png}} was used to represent the "Mac Client" section.

;{{ci|Kayle|size=32|Kayle, the Righteous}}
* '''Kayle''', {{ci|Elise}}, {{ci|Gnar}}, {{ci|Jayce}}, and {{ci|Nidalee}} are the only champions to be conditionally considered both {{tip|ranged}} and {{tip|melee}}.
* The projectile speed of Kayle's basic attack is the third highest in the game among all {{tip|ranged}} attackers that utilize projectiles, at 5000.
** The highest and second highest are {{cai|Severum|Aphelios}} and {{cai|Cultivation of Spirit|Yunara}} at 92400 and 10000, respectively.
* Kayle shares having a non-projectile basic attack in melee range with {{ci|Fiddlesticks}} and {{ci|Samira}}.
* The first buff from her innate ([[File:Kayle Divine Ascent 2.png|20px|link=]] '''Zeal''') shares its name with the item {{ii|Zeal}}.
* Her dance references {{w|Elaine Benes|Elaine Benes'}} [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HQu_NLRvULM dance] from {{w|Seinfeld}}.
** A side-by-side comparison can be seen [https://youtu.be/Db6HGmrm9RM?t=50 here].
* In {{tip|Ultimate Spellbook}}, '''Kayle''' ascends without the player's input. This is caused by the fact that the choosen Ult-ernate Summoner Spells are automatically ranked up when the required levels are reached, which also matches the levels that the player may initiate the ascensions on.

==Trivia==
* Katarina's name comes from Greek Αἰκατερίνα/η (Ekaterine).
** Du Couteau (her family name) is French for "of the knife".
** She shared her namesake with {{ci|Caitlyn}} and {{ci|Kai'Sa}}.
** She may have been inspired by Katherina from {{w|The Taming of the Shrew}} by {{w|William Shakespeare}}.
* {{ai|Shunpo|Katarina}} (pronounced: [ɕʉ͍̃mpo] shoom-poh) comes from Sino-Japanese 瞬歩 "blink step".
* A framed portrait of Katarina's {{csl|Katarina|Original|variant=old2|second splash art}} can be seen in the game's Mac Version trailer.<ref>Youtube — [https://youtu.be/qbPuz48CFnw?si=lTnRywvS8XCfRg0g&t=21 Official Mac Client Trailer (2013) - League of Legends]</ref>
* Katarina - {{ci|Cassiopeia}} is one of seven pairs of sibling champions (the others being {{ci|Kayle}} - {{ci|Morgana}}, {{ci|Garen}} - {{ci|Lux}}, {{ci|Nasus}} - {{ci|Renekton}}, {{ci|Yasuo}} - {{ci|Yone}}, {{ci|Darius}} - {{ci|Draven}}, and {{ci|Vi}} - {{ci|Jinx}}).
** Though not a pair, {{ci|Anivia}}, {{ci|Ornn}}, and {{ci|Volibear}} are also siblings.
* Katarina's dance references {{w|Napoleon Dynamite}}, via [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BiAwpYIkRmU one of its portions].
** She used to share this dance with {{ci|Master Yi}} up until his [[Champion update|rework]], which referenced the other portions.
** A side-by-side comparison can be seen [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=km-FwNjcUyk here].
* {{ais|Voracity|Katarina|image=Voracity.png}} old [[File:Voracity_old.png|20px]] icon was directly edited from her second {{csl|Katarina|Original|variant=old2|Original splash art}}.
* Katarina is one of few champions to feature two '[[Champion Spotlight]]s' due to significant gameplay changes (the others being {{ci|Ezreal}}, {{ci|Karma}}, {{ci|Lee Sin}}, and {{ci|Sivir}}).
* Katarina is one of the first champions to have one skin for each of the three big annual events of the year: [[Lunar Revel]], [[Harrowing]], [[Snowdown Showdown]]. She received her {{csl|Katarina|Warring Kingdoms|Warring Kingdoms}} skin alongside {{cis|Nidalee}} in [[Warring Kingdoms (Universe)|Warring Kingdoms 2015]].
** The other one is {{ci|Jinx}} when she received {{csl|Jinx|Ambitious Elf}} in 2017.
** {{ci|Annie}} almost became another champion that fulfilled the criteria after {{csl|Annie|Panda}} was released in 2013. However, {{csl|Annie|Frostfire}} was not released during the [[Snowdown Showdown]] event.
* A functional real-life replica of Katarina's {{ai|Preparation|Katarina|Daggers}} was crafted in an episode of YouTube series [https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLUUGFk1wE5OFOpfPz3ggXQrCSdQdFEslx Man At Arms: Reforged].
** This video can be viewed [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lq-h3KkF_bY here].
*** There are also videos where the following are crafted:
**** {{cai|Moonfall|Diana|Crescent Moonblade}} ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kz-0nfkVegg functional])
**** {{cai|Zenith Blade|Leona}} ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yEwne-IEG9s functional])
**** {{cai|Highlander|Master Yi|'Highlander' Ring Sword}} ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-EqnHVY1uEo functional])
**** {{cai|Hammer Shock|Poppy|Hammer of Orlon}} ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eqCmrn-80sQ functional])
**** {{cai|Steel Tempest|Yasuo|'Last Breath' Sword}} ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W_7vdfoJApQ functional])
**** {{cai|Short Fuse|Ziggs|Hexplosive Bomb}} ([https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3I6MK1SV1Lk prop])
* Katarina's Series 2 Eternals make the following references:
** ''9 Lives'' is a reference to the myth that cats have 9 lives.

==Trivia==
* His dance references the {{w|Headspin}}, a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5CZBBbnVmUA breakdance move].
** A side-by-side comparison can be seen [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DcayQD_RXQw here.]
* Heimerdinger's alternate/old walk is referred to as [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8KDlwLNDM00 'derpy'.]
** Using any [[Emoting|Emotes]], or activating Heimerdinger's passive will make Heimerdinger alternate between his regular walk and his 'derpy' walk.
* While {{ai|UPGRADE!!!|Heimerdinger}} is active, Heimerdinger gains a cosmetic buff that reads [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gAjR4_CbPpQ 'Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger'.]
* If Heimerdinger scores a Pentakill, he will gain the cosmetic buff {{bi|Eureka!}}
** This buff references {{w|Archimedes}}' sudden revelation, only in Heimerdinger's case his own came after the mass murder of the enemy team.
* Heimerdinger is the sixth champion to have more than four abilities, the others being {{ci|Elise}}, {{ci|Gnar}}, {{ci|Jayce}}, {{ci|Karma}}, {{ci|Lee Sin}}, and {{ci|Nidalee}}.
* The icon for {{ai|Hextech Affinity|Heimerdinger}} is reused for the [[Teamfight Tactics]] item {{TFT Item|Magnetic Remover}}.
* In the now-removed official League of Legends [https://web.archive.org/web/20130726165848/http://forums.na.leagueoflegends.com/board/ forums], the [[File:UPGRADE%21%21%21_old.png|20px]] original icon of {{ai|UPGRADE!!!|Heimerdinger}} was used to represent the "Help & Support" section.

==Trivia==

* Kog'Maw is [[Voice cast (League of Legends)|voiced]] by {{w|Patrick Seitz}}.
** {{ci|Renekton}} is also voiced by the same voice actor, while {{ci|Lucian}} used to be voiced by the same voice actor.
* Kog'Maw's dance references {{w|Michigan J. Frog|Michigan J. Frog's}} [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bkjsN-J27aU dance] from {{w|One Froggy Evening}}.
** A side-by-side comparison can be seen [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A9yOdkGdSkI here].
* Despite {{ai|Icathian Surprise|Kog'Maw}} causing him to blow up, Kog'Maw does have a 'normal' death animation which can only be seen when he's being revived by {{ai|Chronoshift|Zilean}} or {{ii|Guardian Angel}}.
* {{ai|Icathian Surprise|Kog'Maw}} is one of only three abilities that allow their casters to {{tip|Zombie state|continue fighting after death}}, the others being {{ai|Death Defied|Karthus}} and {{ai|Glory in Death|Sion}}.
* Kog'Maw is the only Void-related champion without 'Void' in his title.
* While idle Kog'Maw blinks one eye at a time and sometimes spins around in a manner resembling dogs chasing their own tail.
* Kog'Maw was the first champion to have a joke animation (the second being {{ci|Miss Fortune}}).
* Kog'Maw was first spotted in a screenshot from {{cis|Malzahar}} reveal.
* Maw is another word for mouth.
* Kog'Maw's abilities ironically make no use of his spoken-of and downright-self-stated insatiable hunger.
* Kog'Maw had his game assets reused for several [[featured game mode]]s.
** He was given a retexture and features as a monster called the "Scary Spitty Monster" in {{tip|Invasion}}.
** His animations were reused for the {{ui|Kog'Maw|file=ArcraptorSquare.png|Arcraptor|link=Odyssey: Extraction#Map elements}} and {{ui|Kog'Maw|file=SkitterbeakSquare.png|Skitterbeak|link=Odyssey: Extraction#Map elements}} monsters in {{tip|Odyssey: Extraction}}.
** His model was reused for a mini-boss enemy in {{tip|Swarm}}.
* In the [[April Fool's Patch 2011|V1.0.0.115]] [[April Fools' Day]] patch, he was jokingly listed to receive a skin called '''"Seeing-Eye Kog"''', referencing a seeing-eye dog, another term for {{w|Guide dog}}.

==Trivia==

;{{ci|Gangplank|Original Gangplank|variant=old2|size=32px}}
* During development he was simply called ''Pirate'' or ''Rogal Cheastbeard''.
* Gangplank was named after the eponymous {{w|disembarkation}} device.
* Gangplank is [[Voice cast (League of Legends)|voiced]] by [http://denniscollinsjohnson.com/ Dennis Collins Johnson], who also voices {{ci|Heimerdinger}} and {{ci|Taric|variant=old2|link=Taric/History}}.
* {{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank|image=Parrrley old.png}} being spelled with three R's references {{w|Pirates in popular culture|the pop culture pirate rendition}} and how Gangplank ironically negotiates (as per the word's definition) by killing his opponents and plundering them.
* {{ai|Remove Scurvy|Gangplank|image=Remove Scurvy old.png}} references the real-world disease of {{w|scurvy}}, a disease common in sailors caused by a deficiency in Vitamin C. The high Vitamin C content in oranges is in turn a tongue-in-cheek way to say that eating them can "remove scurvy".
* [http://forums.na.leagueoflegends.com/board/showthread.php?t=912410 NA Summoner 'SantiagoBR'] is the creator of the {{ai|Remove Scurvy|Gangplank|'But I ate some oranges and it was K'|image=Remove Scurvy old.png}} meme.
* During Closed Beta 1 of development, Gangplank didn't have a beard. This was changed in Closed Beta 3. An image of him in this state can be viewed [[:File:Gangplank_Model_01.png|here]].
* His secondary role is {{tip|Support}}.
* In the now-removed official League of Legends [https://web.archive.org/web/20130726165848/http://forums.na.leagueoflegends.com/board/ forums], the [[File:Parrrley_old.png|20px]] original icon of {{ai|Parrrley|Gangplank|image=Parrrley.png}} was used to represent the "Bug Reports" section.

;{{ci|Gangplank|Gangplank, the Saltwater Scourge|size=32px}}
* Gangplank is voiced by {{w|Matthew Mercer}}, who also voices {{csl|Gangplank|Captain}} and {{ci|Kindred|image=ProfileIcon0939 Kindred Wolf.png|Wolf}}.
* He became the first champion to:
*# Receive two [[Champion updates|visual updates]] (the first based on his Chinese artwork and the second based on [[Burning Tides]]).
*# Have four Classic skins (counting {{csl|Gangplank|Captain}} before being disabled in-game after 'dying' in Burning Tides).
*# Temporarily replace the [[announcer]] in every single map.
* One of the scrapped spells tested during Gangplank's visual gameplay update summoned a "pirate {{w|Gundam}}" that fired mid-range cannonballs from its arm and attacked with a miniature version of {{ai|Unstoppable Force|Malphite}}.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/0/https://boards.na.leagueoflegends.com/en/c/developer-corner/VyuLdWhd-intro-james-statikk-bach-champion-update-design-lead?comment=001f000000010000 Statikk on Pirate Gundam]</ref>

==Trivia==

;{{ci|Garen|variant=old|size=32|Garen, the Might of Demacia}}
* Garen was featured in [[Battle Training]] before the tutorials' first revamp.
* His dance is a reference to [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Eo-KmOd3i7s Bye Bye Bye] by {{w|NSYNC}}.
** A side-by-side comparison can be seen [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iipmjFUFPRM here.]
** He used to share this dance with {{ci|Tryndamere}} before they both got [[rework]]ed.
* {{cis|Wukong}} abilities might have been based on Garen's kit. ({{ai|Decisive Strike|Garen}} / {{ai|Crushing Blow|Wukong}}, {{ai|Judgment|Garen}} / {{ai|Cyclone|Wukong}})
* Garen was the first to have his {{IP}} price reduced twice, others being {{ci|Miss Fortune}} and {{ci|Warwick}}.
* The [[:File:Perseverance_old.png|original icon]] of {{ai|Perseverance|Garen|image=Perseverance old.png}} features a silhouette of Garen's pose from his first {{csl|Garen|Original|variant=old|Original splash art}}.
* In the now-removed official League of Legends [https://web.archive.org/web/20130726165848/http://forums.na.leagueoflegends.com/board/ forums], the original icon of {{ai|Perseverance|Garen|image=Perseverance old.png}} was used to represent the "[[Public Beta Environment]]" section.

;{{ci|Garen|size=32|Garen, the Might of Demacia}}
* ''Garen'' Գարեն is an Armenian name, shortened from Old Armenian [https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%D4%B3%D5%A1%D6%80%D5%A5%D5%A3%D5%AB%D5%B6 Գարեգին] ''Garegin'';
** {{w|Hrachia Adjarian|Adjarian}} interprets this name as "{{Tt|highly valued|literally heavily pricy}}", though {{Tt|phonological problems exist|expected form Karegin}}.
** Interestingly, Garen's and {{cis|Lux}} parents both bear {{w|Pre-Greek substrate|Pre-Greek}} names: ''{{Tt|Pieter|father}}'' < Πέτρος "stone" & ''{{Tt|Augatha|mother}}'' < Ᾰ̓γᾰθή "good, fit, noble".<ref>Beekes, R.S.P. ''Etymological Dictionary of Greek'', pp. 1182, 7.</ref>
* {{Champion without ability power ratio|Garen}}
* Garen - {{ci|Lux}} is one of seven pairs of sibling champions (the others being {{ci|Cassiopeia}} - {{ci|Katarina}}, {{ci|Kayle}} - {{ci|Morgana}}, {{ci|Nasus}} - {{ci|Renekton}}, {{ci|Yasuo}} - {{ci|Yone}}, {{ci|Darius}} - {{ci|Draven}}, and {{ci|Vi}} - {{ci|Jinx}}).
** Though not a pair, {{ci|Anivia}}, {{ci|Ornn}}, and {{ci|Volibear}} are also siblings.
* Garen's dance references {{w|Johnny Bravo|Johnny Bravo's}} [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Exe0IEB3hKs dance].
** A side-by-side comparison can be seen [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e6Uc4PlA5jI here.]
* Contrary to popular belief, Garen yells {{sbc|"Demacia!"}} when using {{ai|Courage|Garen}} and not during {{ai|Judgment|Garen}} or {{ai|Demacian Justice|Garen}}.
** Players using these abilities simultaneously led to this confusion.
* The bright and shimmery tonality on Garen's {{ai|Demacian Justice|Garen}} came from a closely mic'd tuning fork and a finger cymbal hitting a broadsword.<ref>[https://nexus.leagueoflegends.com/en-gb/2018/07/the-stories-behind-leagues-sfx/ The Stories Behind League's Sfx]</ref>
* {{ai|Judgment|Garen|''"Spin To Win!"''}} comes from how easily it was for Garen to get kills while using it.
** It earned meme status when [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Pfgap6TAkxU animated] with {{w|Ievan Polkka}} by {{w|Loituma}} playing in the background.
*** When using {{ai|Judgment|Garen}} Garen earns a cosmetic buff that reads ''"Garen is spinning to win"''.
**** The phrase is now associated to every spinning ability (e.g. {{ai|Counter Strike|Jax}}, {{ai|Death Lotus|Katarina}}, {{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}, {{ai|Spinning Slash|Tryndamere}}, and {{ai|Cyclone|Wukong}})
* Garen, {{ci|Zed}}, {{ci|Sona}}, and {{ci|Vi}} were 'targeted' by {{ci|Jhin|Deadeye}}. This is not canon, so much as a teaser for the general theme of '''Jhin''', as '''Zed''' is the only character with any connection.
** After Garen was [https://youtu.be/4N00fqvOAZg shot], his champion icon on his [[League of Legends]] website [https://web.archive.org/web/0/https://na.leagueoflegends.com/en/game-info/champions/garen/ page] and [https://web.archive.org/web/0/https://na.leagueoflegends.com/en/game-info/champions/ champion list] were updated to a [http://2.bp.blogspot.com/-oU-h_fRSMHA/VoGFlR650dI/AAAAAAAA2Wc/HRLPM9m0Txg/s1600/KpxJ32P%2B-%2BImgur.gif gif] with what seems to be shards of some sort floating out.

* Jinx's dance is a reference to {{f|AdventureTime|Jake|Jake's}} [https://youtu.be/E5KC1E5NyR0?t=17 dance] from ''{{w|Adventure Time}}'' animated series, specifically since the {{f|AdventureTime|Power Animal}} episode.
** A side-by-side comparison can be seen [http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fpRypccXif8 here].
* {{ais|Super Mega Death Rocket!|Jinx}} blast radius displays a {{w|smiley}} face upon impact.
** {{ai|Get Excited!|Jinx}} also displays a smiley face over Jinx upon activation.
* Jinx is the first champion whose laugh animation automatically loops.
* Jinx's hair (or scarf on {{csl|Jinx|Crime City}}) forms a heart when she dies.
* Jinx is the only champion to have all her ability names end in an exclamation mark.
* Whenever Jinx is on the opposing team, {{ci|Vi}} and/or {{ci|Caitlyn}} each gain the {{bi|Catch me if you can!}} cosmetic debuff.
* On 21 August 2018, women have statistically attributed Jinx as "The most visually appealing champion in League".<ref>[https://twitter.com/RiotBlaustoise/status/1032104974493204482 Riot Blaustoise Jinx data tweet]</ref>
* Jinx is the third champion to have one skin for each of the three big annual events of the year - [[Lunar Revel]], [[Harrowing]] and [[Snowdown Showdown]]. The skin that gave her this distinction was {{csl|Jinx|Ambitious Elf}} in 2017.

** {{ci|Annie}} almost became another champion that fulfilled the criteria after {{csl|Annie|Panda}} was released in 2013. However, {{csl|Annie|Frostfire}} was not released during the [[Snowdown Showdown]] event.
* Jinx - {{ci|Vi}} is one of seven pairs of sibling champions (the others being {{ci|Cassiopeia}} - {{ci|Katarina}}, {{ci|Kayle}} - {{ci|Morgana}}, {{ci|Nasus}} - {{ci|Renekton}}, {{ci|Garen}} - {{ci|Lux}}, {{ci|Yasuo}} - {{ci|Yone}}, and {{ci|Darius}} - {{ci|Draven}}).
** Though not a pair, {{ci|Anivia}}, {{ci|Ornn}}, and {{ci|Volibear}} are also siblings.
* Jinx's Series 2 [[Eternals]] make the following references:
** ''It Worked!'' is a reference to the infamous Explosive Monkey that she created to 'save' the other family members from [[Universe:Arcane (TV Series)/Season 1/Episode 3|episode 3]] of the {{tip|Arcane}} animated series.
* Jinx's classic splash background is a demolished version of {{ci|Vi}}'s background.

==Trivia==

* A fully-stacked {{ai|Rend|Kalista}} has the highest AD ratio in the game {{as|({{ap|60+20*253 to 60+35*253}}% AD)}}.
* '''Kalista''' has the longest basic [[attack windup]] time of all champions, however this is easily offset by her high base attack speed and attack speed scaling.
* Kalista's dance references {{wikia|IceAndFire|Oberyn Martell|Oberyn Martell's}} [https://youtu.be/HwHdFSpoObY?t=13 spear dance] from {{w|Game of Thrones}}.
** A side-by-side comparison can be seen [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yLDJWigzkbA here].
* Kalista's '[[Champion Spotlight]]' was the first to feature the updated [[Summoner's Rift]] map.
* {{ci|Kalista|The Spear of Vengeance}} resembles {{ci|Varus|the Arrow of Retribution}}.
* {{ii|Black Spear}} is the third champion-unique item, the first being {{ii|Prototype Hex Core}} ({{cis|Viktor}}) and the second being {{ai|Bonetooth Necklace|Rengar}} ({{cis|Rengar}} before it merged with {{ai|Unseen Predator|Rengar}}).
* Kalista's usage of {{w|nosism}} (referring to oneself using a plural pronoun), as well as the echo in her voice, resembles {{wikia|MortalKombat|Ermac}} from {{w|Mortal Kombat}}.
* Kalista targeted many betrayers for execution during [[Harrowing]] 2014.
*# {{ci|Cassiopeia}} for [https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://promo.na.leagueoflegends.com/video-teasers/intro-cassiopeia.webm backstabbing] {{ci|Sivir}}.
*# {{ci|Hecarim}} for his [https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://promo.na.leagueoflegends.com/video-teasers/intro-hecarim.webm treachery] against her in the Blessed Isles.
*# {{ci|LeBlanc}} for aiding the [[Noxus|barbarian invaders]] against {{ci|Mordekaiser}} as well as betraying countless others.
*# {{ci|Lissandra}} for [https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://promo.na.leagueoflegends.com/video-teasers/intro-lissandra.webm murdering] Avarosa for her spearheading the rebellion against the Frozen Watchers.
*# {{ci|Twisted Fate}} for [https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://promo.na.leagueoflegends.com/video-teasers/intro-twistedfate.webm abandoning] {{ci|Graves}} to be imprisoned in the Locker (Kalista is trying to convince the Outlaw to 'give in to his hate' despite being told by the Card Master he and their crew did try to get him out, reconciling their differences and settling the feud)
*# {{ci|Xerath}} for [https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://promo.na.leagueoflegends.com/video-teasers/intro-xerath.webm plotting] against {{ci|Azir}} and laying waste to Ancient Shurima.
*# {{ci|Zed}} for [https://web.archive.org/web/0/http://promo.na.leagueoflegends.com/video-teasers/intro-zed.webm murdering] {{cis|Shen}} father Kusho, slaughtering the Kinkou Order, and founding the Order of Shadow over the remains of their monastery.
* Kalista's Series 1 [[Eternals]] make the following references:
** ''Rip and R.I.P.'' is a reference to the phrase ''"Rip and Tear"'', originating from the "Metal Militia" song from the album {{w|Kill 'Em All}} by the {{w|Metallica}} heavy metal band and popularized by the ''{{w|Doom (franchise)|DOOM}}'' franchise.
* The asset for the ''Sentinel'' was re-used in the Featured Game Mode [[Hunt of the Blood Moon|Hunt of the Blood Moon's]] ''Spirits''.

==Trivia==

* Ivern is an {{w|anagram}} of {{ci|Riven}}.
* On [[V9.20]], Ivern became the first champion to have its range type changed, from {{tip|Melee}} to {{tip|Ranged}}.
* If Ivern {{ai|Daisy!|Ivern|summons}} Daisy and then dances, she will also dance.
* {{ai|Daisy!|Ivern|Daisy's}} animations were reused from the {{ui|Blue Sentinel|possessive=true}}.
** Because of this, she shared its dance, which references [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FLPLgJqeZJw Open the Door] by {{w|Im Chang-jung}}.
*** Before the rework of the {{ui|Rift Herald|image=Rift_HeraldSquare_old.png}} in patch [[V7.9]], she also shared this dance with her.
* The [[Raptor camp]] features in the icon of his {{ai|Friend of the Forest|Ivern}} ability.
* Ivern is the only champion to have a non standard (55, 65, or 80) [[Unit radius]].
** Nobody knows why, exactly.<ref>[https://twitter.com/Squad5lol/status/1286432100795559936 Squad5lol on Ivern's unit radius]</ref>
